messages:
zane: heads up — apiserver 5xx spike in eu-west1 right after NAT rebalancer finished (06:12). Controller-manager leader elections noisy, GPU provisioner backlog rising. paging @oncall :rotating_light:

sre-bot: [ALERT] apiserver_5xx_rate > 5% (eu-west1) — triggered at 2026-03-21T06:13:02Z

lucy: looking at grafana -> https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/apiserver?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west1

ajay: logs show lots of tcp retransmits around 06:11-06:13, looks like SNAT conn exhaustion on nat-zw3

maria: provisioning queue: provisioner/pool-gpu pending=72 -> nodes not attaching, API timeouts for attach calls

ken: can we revert the nat rebalancer? it was a config push at 06:10 by infra-ops

oncall: reverting now, will post rollback ts

deploy-bot: Revert initiated by oncall: rollback-change-20260321-natrebal

sre-bot: revert complete at 2026-03-21T06:18:40Z; health check OK for NAT hosts

lucy: apiserver 5xx dropping after revert but controller-manager leader election still jittery. lease renew failures in logs

ajay: controller-manager logs show repeated "failed to update lease" with timeout; kube-proxy conntrack hits high

zane: quick commands I ran to inspect conntrack/conn state:
```
sudo conntrack -L | grep nat | wc -l
sudo ss -tn sport :443 | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l
```

maria: temp mitigation: scaled provisioner replicas to 5 -> queue drained from 72 -> 12 in ~3m, attach success rate improving

oncall: GPU pool attach success back to normal for most regions; apiserver 95p latency back under SLO

ken: cost note — scaling provisioner up increases short-term spend. please track and revert when stable

zane: agree. filing follow-up ticket for capacity/resilience: https://redwood.internal/tickets/RI-2371

lucy: adding postmortem tag, collecting apiserver/controller/provisioner logs + nat metrics. if anyone has pcap, upload to /incidents/6743219876/pcap

ajay: follow-up actions: add SNAT exhaustion alert, conntrack saturation dashboard, and runbook step to throttle rebalancer pushes during peak attach windows

maria: thanks all — will keep eyes on metrics for 1h before closing the loop

oncall: closing ops loop for now, handing to eng to drive RCA. great job coordinating :thumbsup:
